newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures wander in mixed ranges.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures wander in mixed ranges.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. stock index futures wandered in mixed ranges after midday. Traders said action had wound down from a brisk early-morning pace, with price boards showing June volume near 43,000. Some said June S&Ps could have slightly more downside heading into Friday's April US jobs report but they doubted the contract would pierce Wednesday's low at 795.25.
